text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 23,960.6, up 0.63% on the day and 5.56% over the last five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 1.10% (5‑day gain 4.79%). Advances outpaced declines with 404 stocks up versus 87 down, giving a breadth score of 60.3 and a “healthy” market tone. The India VIX fell to 15.19, down 3.37% on the day, indicating lower volatility.  

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding INR 14,974.68 crore today and a 5‑day total of INR 35,808.74 crore, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold INR 10,444.54 crore (5‑day net sell INR 19,045.33 crore). Sector breadth shows leading strength in Infrastructure, Oil & Gas, Pharma and FMCG, with weakening in IT and Financial Services. In options, Nifty’s put‑call ratio (PCR) is 1.34, max‑pain sits at 24,350 and the expected range is 24,259‑24,814; a call wall at 25,000 and put wall at 23,000 may cap moves.  

Watch the Nifty pivot levels: support at 23,784.3 (S1) and resistance at 24,048.75 (R1), with the 200‑day moving average near 24,008.7. A break below S1 could test the put wall, while a move above R1 may push the index toward the call wall. In Bank Nifty, the pivot point is 55,718.3, with support at 55,489.8 and resistance at 56,142.1; the 200‑day average sits at 56,649.4. Keep an eye on global cues such as US equity weakness and crude‑oil price easing, which could influence the next session. (PCR = put‑call ratio, a measure of option‑side bias.)
